title: Interview met Tonny Beentjes, Ede, 14 januari 2026

contacts.name: Data Steward of the Faculty of Humanity

descriptions: Interview conducted in the context of the course Oral History and Artwork Life Stories at the University of Amsterdam. The interview was held in person in Ede on 14 January 2026 with Tonny Beentjes, restorer and conservator (metal). His education, professional career, and restoration practice were discussed, including experiences in the Netherlands and the United Kingdom.
